europe_now.title: Estonia Closes Border Following Sabotage Attempt
europe_now.summary: Estonia has announced the closure of its border crossings with Russia after accusing Moscow of orchestrating an attempted arson attack on a local defense manufacturing firm.

europe_now.title: Czech Demonstrations Against Public Media Reforms
europe_now.summary: Large crowds of demonstrators have gathered in Prague to protest government plans altering the funding structure and operation of public media institutions.

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Border Actions
top_stories.summary: Tallinn has decided to shut down its border crossings with Russia following a targeted sabotage attempt at a domestic defense facility. The incident highlights heightened security concerns across the Baltic region regarding infrastructure protection.

top_stories.title: Public Media Protests in Czechia
top_stories.summary: Thousands of citizens assembled in Prague to voice strong opposition against proposed legislative changes affecting public broadcaster funding. The ongoing dispute has also prompted high-profile departures within state television organizations.
